decision_scope: Bounded graph/policy review against directly relevant held RSTR/PCE and current PSBR plus original M95 middle FFN. Not full historical or literature novelty clearance, efficacy, native correctness or admission.

proposal_snapshot.operator: Within each original ids2 parent, select true point-supported middle rows, sort detached original cached geometry xyz then original middle ID. With orthonormal DCT-II Q and original f=F1 o LN1, b=f(0), return Y=X+Q^T(f(QX)-b)+b, then inverse scatter to original IDs.
proposal_snapshot.parameter_scope: Reuse original middle FFN/LN parameters and original residual; fine/coarse/raw CSORT/HCG/last inst_feats update retained.
proposal_snapshot.single_FFN_scope: Append zero sentinel to private middle working rows so f is called once; sentinel never enters raw banks, IDs, masks or HCG; unsupported actual IDs and padding retain original FFN semantics.
proposal_snapshot.proposal_basis: Current root task and new_variant direct proposal clarification, not a tested source.

RSTR.held_graph: After existing fine FFN, per fine-to-middle sibling group/head, form content-affinity softmax and pi-reversible nonnegative row-stochastic P; replace refined fine T with P(T,pi)T; conserve point-mass-weighted pre-fusion mean.
RSTR.proposed_difference: Middle pre/post-FFN conjugation by a fixed signed orthogonal basis; no affinity, pi/masses, stochastic probability or detailed-balance correction. Learned nonlinear f is evaluated in mixed coefficient coordinates and synthesized back. Group size or level change alone would not be sufficient, but these operator and invariant differences are substantive.
RSTR.reversible_word_boundary: RSTR reversibility means Markov detailed balance, not merely an invertible analysis/synthesis basis.
RSTR.hold_preserved: RSTR committed failure1/32 at1.027033878e-6>1e-6 and consumed2 revisions stay held. This proposal neither fixes/retests that version nor inherits its PASS or relaxes its promised conservation gate.

PCE.held_graph: Physical-contact cross-fine-leaf point/sp feature attention, content query/key/value exchange along geometry contacts, with fine readback override.
PCE.proposed_difference: No physical contact edges, point donors or cross-leaf point attention; fixed bounded middle-token group basis surrounding the original FFN before unchanged HCG. No PCE revision or implication that its numerical failure was cleared.

PSBR.active_graph: Replace middle FFN with learned bidirectional Wx/Wh/Wo recurrent sibling chain under same coarse parent.
PSBR.proposed_difference: Same broad sibling-information question, distinct all-group spectral-domain FFN graph; original middle FFN retained, no learned recurrent state/new projection parameters. This is not evidence of a different diagnosed dataset defect or efficacy.

mathematics.input_Jacobian: dY_i/dX_j = delta_ij I + sum_k Q[k,i]*Q[k,j]*J_f((QX)_k). Off-diagonal terms are generally nonzero when nonlinear local Jacobians differ.
mathematics.affine_degeneracy: For affine f(z)=zW+b the conjugation cancels and recovers original X+f(X); near-equal local Jacobians can make interaction negligible. The actual native path must be measured, not presumed from syntax.
mathematics.control_identities: Q=I, singleton n1, and all-zero X recover the baseline mathematically. They do not establish bitwise FP32 equality because subtraction/addition and Q matmuls round.
mathematics.nonzero_constant_risk: For identical nonzero tokens the DC coefficient is scaled by sqrt(n), other modes are zero, and nonlinear f need not commute with this scaling. The output generally differs from original per-token f(X), so this is not a constant-field or mean-preserving operator and may change calibration/group-size behavior.
mathematics.bias_autograd: b=f(0) must retain autograd through original LN/FFN. Detaching b changes parameter gradients and the proposed graph.

policy_boundary.not_pure_scaling_or_activation_sweep: Nonlinear analysis/synthesis changes cross-token information dependencies; original activation/dropout/seed/init values remain fixed. No new residual branch is added; original residual stays. Affine degeneration and interaction controls make this claim falsifiable.
policy_boundary.not_gate_routing_QKV_attnpool: No learned gate, language/query route, QKV projection or learned attention/pooling weights proposed. Fixed DCT mixing is not itself a probability attention pool.
policy_boundary.no_novelty_gate_invented: Literature-level novelty/positive tiny-cohort gain is not demanded before the experiment-first technical screen. Public novelty/benefit remain UNKNOWN.
policy_boundary.no_historical_hold_override: General project authorization/timers/new names do not reopen old held candidates. No permission for RSTR R3/PCE R4 or altered conservation/precision/thresholds is inferred.

implementation_and_numeric_risks: Keep the original FPS/partition IDs and cached geometry; never rerun/redefine FPS, repool geometry under changed semantics, compact token IDs or sort actual point inputs. Original middle ID is a tie breaker within one fixed scene, not proof of invariance to global token renumbering.

True support must follow composed original point-to-fine-to-middle IDs, e.g. ids1[ids0]; a valid prefix alone does not exclude internal empty IDs. Q is only over occupied rows of that original parent. Preserve original unsupported/empty FFN bias and batch padding outside Q.

The private zero sentinel must not enter cluster IDs/maps/raw CSORT/HCG or scene masks. Run original LN+FFN once on the private work tensor; keep b gradients and common parameter names/initialization.

Original native YAML dropout is0.0. Preserve it; with nonzero dropout the b/control identities and sentinel RNG consumption would need different analysis. Do not change dropout to obtain a passing check.

Record FP32 Q orthogonality/analysis-synthesis roundoff, finite outputs/gradients, Q=I/singleton/zero controls and real off-diagonal same-parent dependence. Pre-register controls/tolerances before execution rather than borrowing RSTR weighted-mean conservation or relaxing failed controls.

DCT basis constants may be built deterministically then represented in FP32; feature forward/backward precision must stay original. Do not insert runtime FP64 feature math or precision/normalization tuning.

Singleton can be handled by the algebraically original direct FFN result to preserve its exact baseline path, but disclose this fast path and still test actual non-singleton transforms. Nontrivial empty and padding coverage must be recorded rather than inferred from vacuous assertions.

minimal_discriminating_controls.baseline: Original M95 plus explicit identity-basis mode, with same model/init/native data; baseline result and operator identity check are distinct claims.
minimal_discriminating_controls.same_parent_dependency: Fixed nonconstant native output probe should reveal finite off-diagonal sibling gradients for n>1 where actually exercised; across-parent gradients zero at this local operator. No universal nonzero claim at all-zero/affine-degenerate inputs.
minimal_discriminating_controls.association_control: If probing geometric association, pre-register one deterministic within-parent column permutation R: Q_control=Q R, synthesize with (Q R)^T on the same input/output ID domain. Same n/basis orthogonality/operator/weights/parameter counts; do not choose a favorable permutation after results.
minimal_discriminating_controls.avoid_equivalent_control: A coefficient-row permutation S gives (S Q)^T[f(S Q X)-b] = Q^T[f(QX)-b] because shared rowwise f commutes with S. It is an equivalent identity control, not a wrong-geometric-association control.
minimal_discriminating_controls.native_screen: Original YAML/pretrain/seed and real2step loss/backward, actual f/branch gradients, exact paired data/init scope, standard original-handler bs1/warm20/repeat100 resource pair. No positive-benefit admission gate invented.

resource_risks.complexity: Two transforms cost O(C*sum_g n_g^2), n_total<=original64 middle tokens; no pointN^2/QKV. Original middle FFN is retained plus private sentinel cost.
resource_risks.limits: Small theoretical FLOPs do not establish actual latency. Per-group Python/kernel launch, coordinate sorting, basis construction and unsupported operators must be reported under existing profile plus actual timing/memory. No custom handler or token-size sweep. Total<=10G and existing memory condition unchanged.

implementation_recommendation: Proceed only with a separately registered stable candidate and new external preparation files under this tick; do not alter Cluster/HEAD, existing PSBR74f queue/readiness or HRC running source. This review supports implementation feasibility, not tested correctness/admission.
